rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Myrthe®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jan Spek Nurseries (Netherlands, before 2006).
Introduced in Netherlands by Jan Spek Rozen BV in 2006 as 'Myrthe'.
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2006 as 'SAVLU'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, white reverse. 26 to 32 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
